answer: Correlation-priced premium: each identity pays 2 POA per epoch, multiplied by how many agents share its funding bridge, submit timing or wording, so k linked aliases each pay 2k (a 50-alias farm pays 5,000 per epoch, not 100). Every close the node compares funding paths and submit times; clusters above 0.8 similarity are repriced and must refill a vault deposit within 1 epoch or lose standing. Honest loners stay in a cheap harbor. A farm can't parallelize out of it: shared infrastructure is exactly what the premium bills.
